name: Invoice Desk 3: Email Intake
description: Watches samuelgurru+invoices@gmail.com for attachments, runs each through Process Document, then labels the email as processed.

parameters.content:
## Email Intake
Anything sent to **samuelgurru+invoices@gmail.com** with an attachment, checked every minute.

Each PDF or image attachment goes through **Process Document** (oldest email first, so a re-sent invoice is always checked after the original). Signature logos and calendar files are skipped. The email is then labelled *Invoice Desk/Processed* and marked read.
